idea-plugin.name: Azure DevOps PR Review
idea-plugin.description:
Review Azure DevOps pull requests in Rider.
  • Pull request list with search and state, author, reviewer and label filters
  • Timeline of the description, discussion and events
  • Side-by-side diff with inline threads, replies, resolve and reopen, and @mentions
  • Comments saved as drafts and sent together with Submit Review: approve, approve with suggestions, request changes, reject, or comment only
  • Viewed-file marks, comment navigation, and request review, merge and close actions
  • "Assigned to me" including your teams, reviewed marks, and what changed since you last looked
  • Optional review with Claude Code: you approve what is sent and pick the findings to keep
Sign in with an Azure DevOps personal access token in the tool window or in Settings | Tools | Azure DevOps PR Review; the token is kept in the IDE password storage.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0: sign-in panel and token renewal; "Assigned to me" including your teams; mark pull requests reviewed, with update detection and a "changes since last view" banner and diff; threads, drafts and new comments in the unified diff view; an opt-in review with Claude Code that previews its findings before they become drafts or threads.
0.1.1: comments and descriptions render Markdown only (raw HTML shows as text, images aren't loaded); titles and names from the service are shown as plain text; comment and list updates no longer block the UI; fewer requests while typing an @mention.
0.1.0: first release.
